# Max Smith

> Max (Maxwell) Smith is a software engineer in Mountain View, California, in the San Francisco Bay Area. He grew up in Ankeny, Iowa, and moved west in 2022. This is his personal site; opinions are his own and don't represent any employer.

## Facts

- Current role: Software Engineer at Apple (since 2025). No details about current work are published here.
- Previously: Software Engineer at PlayStation (Sony Interactive Entertainment) in San Francisco, 2022–2025, working on web, mobile and desktop apps in React and React Native.
- Founder and engineer of SeasonCast (Ankeny, Iowa, 2019–2024), a live-streaming platform for high school and youth sports that reached 300,000+ monthly users.
- Internships: Hy-Vee (Des Moines, Iowa, 2021), Polaris (Medina, Minnesota, 2020), Tero International (Clive, Iowa, 2019).
- How he works: builds whole systems and keeps them running (SeasonCast: 99.995% uptime over three years). On his own projects he runs a small team of AI agents, each with a small ticket, a check to pass and a review before merge.
- Education: B.S. Computer Science, Iowa State University (Ames, Iowa), 2022. A.A.S., Des Moines Area Community College, 2019.
